rollups.text: Horror and thriller interests: On 2023-05-20, the user said she loves intensely frightening horror and thrillers, and that the Joker in The Dark Knight (2008) creeped her out. She had already seen Hereditary (2018), The Silence of the Lambs (1991), Saw (2004), Get Out (2017), and The Cabin in the Woods (2011), but did not find them scary enough; she was excited to watch The Descent (2005) and The Witch (2015).

Musical theater and screen productions the user enjoyed or considered: She saw Hadestown on Broadway in 2019 and loves its music and storytelling; after watching the 2022 Tony Awards on 2022-06-12, she was reminded how much she loved it. On 2021-11-25, she was leaning toward Once for its introspective, emotional sound and had been listening nonstop to the Dear Evan Hansen soundtrack since seeing the film adaptation that day. She particularly likes the soundtracks of The Book of Mormon, including “Hasa Diga Eebowai” and “You and Me (But Mostly Me),” and hopes to see its touring production. She thought Moulin Rouge! might appeal to her. She enjoys The Great and Bridgerton for their visually impressive costumes and production design; she binge-watched The Great season 2 from 2021-12-18 through 2021-12-22 and finished Bridgerton season 2 on 2022-04-10.

The user has recurring interests and activities in music and the arts. She plays acoustic guitar and has tried fingerstyle exercises to improve finger independence, aiming to practice at least 30 minutes every other day but finding consistency difficult. She has experimented with Ableton Live and planned an indie-electronic track using Drum Rack, Simpler, Serum, and Pigments. She completed three paintings over a few months by 2023-05-27, likes mixed media and abstract expressionism, and wanted to incorporate fabric into a painting. She has seen Marina Abramović’s work, found it powerful, and especially enjoyed Laurie Anderson’s “Language of the Future” for its combination of music and spoken word; she wanted to see performance art in person.

The user has pursued dance, yoga, and fitness activities. By 2023-05-22, she had taken Saturday salsa classes for about two months, felt core and leg soreness afterward, and said salsa had significantly increased her energy. She wanted to learn new moves, improve technique, and add core and leg workouts. She had practiced yoga for about three months by 2023-05-22 and found it helpful for stress relief; she uses Down Dog guided breathing, loved a restorative class at Yoga Bliss using blocks and bolsters, and intended to add restorative yoga to her routine. She wanted a consistent morning yoga practice but struggled to get up early, and was considering a June 2023 alignment workshop.

The user described recurring food interests and plans: by 2023-05-27 she enjoyed nearly daily hummus with carrots, cucumbers, and cherry tomatoes after lunch, liked overnight oats, and made a large batch of quinoa every Sunday. She planned quinoa breakfast bowls with sliced almonds and chia seeds. For a planned brunch, she chose Mediterranean Delight and Spicy Kick vegetable-and-dip combinations, plus Cucumber-Mint Refresher and Ginger-Peach Spritzer. On 2023-05-29, she said she had been using oat milk frequently and planned vegan Mushroom Bolognese with cremini mushrooms, adding vegan “chick'n” parmesan near the end of cooking.

Purchases mentioned by the user: On 2023-05-09, she bought herself a limited-edition Chanel bag for $3,500 as a birthday present. By 2023-05-23, she also reported buying an Omega watch for $8,000 at a high-end SoHo watch store, a luxury skincare set for her sister’s birthday, affordable fashion pieces from Target, a designer wallet, an Amazon phone case, and Jimmy Choo heels at an outlet mall. Prices were not given for the latter items except the Omega watch.

Online-shopping spending management: From April 2023 through 2023-05-20, the user made at least one online purchase per week, sometimes two or three, and felt overwhelmed by mindless shopping and unsure of the total spent. On 2023-05-20, she planned to start a spending journal and use a budgeting app; she initially considered Mint, YNAB, and Personal Capital, leaned toward free and user-friendly Mint, asked about account-link security, and decided to link her financial accounts to Mint to understand spending and cut back. By 2023-05-23, she was also tracking expenses in spreadsheets, considering customizable categories and automated categorization, and planned to monitor luxury purchases for a few months before setting a flexible guideline and reviewing it regularly.

Second-grade teaching team formation: On 2023-05-21, the user was assembling an effective four-teacher team at her elementary school, focused on reading comprehension and mathematics, with three existing teachers and the option to hire one more. The existing teachers included an 11-year veteran seeking leadership, a second-year teacher with prior reading-intervention experience, and a transfer teacher with five years’ experience who had not yet started. The user aimed to make the team the school’s highest-performing team. She then sought team-building reading and exercises and a job description emphasizing differentiated reading and math instruction, collaboration, growth mindset, classroom management, assessment, family communication, and professional learning. The conversation supplied book and team-activity suggestions and a draft job description; no completed hire or final team outcome was reported.

Yoga practice development: By 2023-05-22, the user had practiced yoga for about three months, found it helpful for stress relief, used Down Dog breathing exercises, and loved a restorative class at Yoga Bliss. She wanted a consistent morning routine but struggled to get up early, and planned to incorporate restorative yoga more often. She was considering a June 2023 workshop on alignment and form, areas she wanted to improve. The records do not confirm that she attended the workshop or established the routine.

Zombie game development: By 2023-05-24, the user was developing a game with a prologue and three major story paths, hoping maps would make timelines ambiguous unless players investigated clues. In Path 3, Marcus’s missed shot kills Dr. Penelope; Surgey then kills Marcus and Jillian. Surgey flees, the outbreak devastates the Americas, and infections spread to other continents. In a later proposed ending, a mentally deteriorated Surgey deceives bunker survivors into carrying out a parasite-laden bombing scheme against the USSR, resulting in worldwide apocalypse. The user welcomed adding smaller branches from player choices. The story also featured seven Amplified zombie types: Jugernaut, Hydra, Skullcrawler, Beserker, Lasher, Hoplite, and Fissionator. Suggested placement varied by path, and the user approved the suggestions. The conversation also developed possible maps and story situations; no finished game was reported.

rollups.text: Tarahumara language-preservation interest: On 2023-05-25, the user expressed interest in documenting and preserving Indigenous languages in Central and South America, asked about organizations and participation, then focused on the Tarahumara language project in Mexico because of her long-standing interest in Mexico’s Indigenous cultures. She asked about the project and how she might contribute, then requested a walkthrough of documentation stages and possible tasks. The assistant described preparation and community consent, recording, transcription and analysis, learning materials, archiving, and potential volunteer roles. The project details and opportunities were assistant-provided and were not independently confirmed; no participation was reported.
rollups.topic: exploring contribution to Tarahumara language documentation

She was considering hosting an abstract-expressionist painting party at home, with easy-to-eat finger foods and drinks, art books or prints, and multiple painting stations featuring materials and methods such as paint pouring and sponges.
